programme.desc: Behind the Wings host Matthew Burchette goes behind the scenes with DENs snow removal team, talks to the CFO who helped to finance one of the largest airport expansions in the world and even takes a trip below ground, where there might be more than meets the eye.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: Explore the CAG bird inside Wings Over the Rockies Air & Space Museum and take a trip to Naval Air Station Whidbey Island to visit the home of electronic attack for the entire DoD. Youll find yourself on the runway with EA-18s screaming by, face to face with active pilots leading the Navys mission and take a tour of a Navy base built to protect the USAs Western coast during WWII.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: Join Behind the Wings host Matthew Burchette as he goes flying with a Metropolitan State University of Denver student over some of Denvers most popular landmarks, learns about the desperate need for airline pilots and gets a soup to nuts look at the 172 Skyhawk in Independence, Kansas.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: The UH-1 Iroquois (Huey) is THE iconic aircraft of the Vietnam War. In the season 2 premiere of Behind the Wings, take a trip to Wings Over the Rockies Air & Space Museum in Denver, CO with host Matthew Burchette as he highlights a combat-veteran Huey, interviews two Vietnam War Huey pilots and even tags along on a training mission with the US Coast Guard to showcase the U.S. militarys latest helo.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: In this special episode of Behind the Wings, tag along as host Matthew Burchette explores one of the militarys best-kept secrets - North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD). Get a private tour of the N2C2 command center, experience a Noble Eagle Conference in action and fly along as Matthews venture into restricted airspace puts him up close and personal with Buckley AFBs 140th Wing. This is access that few ever receive.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: 2019 marked the 50th anniversary of the Apollo 11 lunar landing. This incredible milestone changed the way humanity looked at our planet and access to deep space. Join Behind the Wings host Matthew Burchette as he sits down with NASAs Gene Kranz, summarizes the amazing events leading up to Apollo 11 and uncovers the fascinating future NASA has in store for space exploration.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: The Beechcraft Company has been in existence for more than 88 years and has built some of the most influential aircraft in history. Join host Matthew Burchette as he dives into the history of the iconic Beechcraft 18, explores its history as the C-45 Expeditor and ventures to Centennial Airport in Englewood, Colorado to link up with the Colorado State Patrols (CSP) Aviation Section. If you are lucky, you may even get a ride in CSPs souped-up Beechcraft King Air.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: Wildfires are growing in intensity, and firefighting aviation is becoming increasingly crucial to saving forests and lives in Colorado and beyond. Fire aviation teams are critical, complex efforts, made up of pilots, technicians, and coordinators who work together with ground crews to put out and contain wildfires. As environmental conditions set the stage for unprecedented fire seasons, night vision goggle technology is employed for the first time, and Colorado legislatures are paying closer attention than ever to the importance of wildfires. The progress is clear, yet so much remains to be done.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: New fire conditions call for new firefighting methods and tools. Looking at Calfire, we learn how the largest municipal fleet of firefighting aircraft in the world has developed over time. Live data feeds revolutionize how firefighting teams understand fires and communicate during missions. Colorado gets ready to purchase its first Firehawk helicopter, and interagency teams coordinate at the local, state, and federal levels. The challenges in fighting wildfires are greater than ever, but with new methods of fighting the fires, so are the opportunities.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: In the 1950s, The Century Series defined an era of aviation during the Cold War, charting a metamorphosis from one era to another. Jets were in their infancy, and many milestones, including the sound barrier, loomed large. In an arms race with the Soviet Union, a rising superpower, the U.S. got to work developing a variety of impressive fighter jets, now known as the Century Series. Starting with the F-100, the first production airplane to break the sound barrier in level flight, we explore how the century series pioneered new airplane designs, including the aerodynamic coke bottle shape made famous by the F-102. The F-104, a missile with a man in it inspired a generation of pilots. The F-105 looked like a fighter but was a bomber in disguise. As a series, their legacy is evident in modern fighter jets.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: For nearly sixty years the Learjet came to define a new class of luxury airplane the business jet. Now, the last Learjet ever is being assembled at the Wichita-based production facility in The Aviation Capital of the World. Speaking with aviation icons past and present, we get an intimate look at a company that shaped aviation as we know it today. From its record-setting performance achievements to its outsized role in popular culture, the Learjets place in history is here to stay, long after the production lines shut down.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range.Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots.From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves.As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field.With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: In Episode 10 Boat Trader heads to central Texas to explore boating culture in the lone star state. Second only to Alaska in size, Texas is known as the place where everything is bigger. From big college football games to endless oil fields and vast wind farms, Texas is home to more than 30 million Americans. But the state is about more than just big oil, college football and cattle farms - it's also home to some of the best boating in the country. Boasting a myriad of waterways, boaters here enjoy hundreds of lakes, rivers and streams that provide recreational opportunities, abundant wildlife and plenty of fishing. From Austin Texas to San Antonio host Ryan McVinney and the Boat Trader crew explore the laid-back Texas lake life including boat up restaurants along the Colorado River, watersports in Austin and the history of the waterways throughout the region. Boat manufacturers highlighted in this episode are Tige Boats and ATX Surf Boats, two premium Texas-based wake boat brands known for their high-quality, cutting-edge vessels that come equipped with advanced wake shaping technologies and equipment ideal for water skiing, wake surfing and wakeboarding. There's even a wake surfing dog!

programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by airand sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned—again and again—carrying Brett’s body, circling the tree where his friends clung to life. It wasn’t just hunting. It was showing them something. Was this predator defending its territory? Sending a message? Or acting with something more than instinct?In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we examine the terrifying true story of Brett Mann—and ask:When nature strikes back… is it ever personal?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean.These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories.We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii’s coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff explore the breathtaking Waipio Valley, the Hawaiian "Valley of the Kings," in search of prawns and bullfrogs. Their adventure continues up a massive volcano, hunting invasive rams, before ending with a feast of native fish paired with island fruits and spices.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, follow along as Mark Peterson sets out on his second attempt in British Columbia for a Stone Sheep with his Gunwerks muzzleloader. After dealing with terrible weather and not many sheep encounters on his first hunt, Mark is eager to fill his tag this time around. Traveling to some of the best areas for sheep, Mark and the crew have a spectacular week of sheep encounters along with multiple close calls that will tear you down and drive you crazy!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This week is all about Woody, a fearless Jack Russle who spends his free time doing everything from Black Bear hunting in Vancouver to Sheep hunting in the mountains.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Follow along as Mark Peterson travels to Tanzania to hunt the Eastern and Western White-Bearded Wildebeest. These animals are known for their distinctive white beards and large horns, making them a sought-after trophy for hunters on an African safari. Mark sets out on an exciting and thrilling adventure to track down these elusive creatures in the plains of Tanzania.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson heads out on a unique hunt for the rare Anatolian Chamois, a mountain dweller found in the high elevations of northern Turkey. With a storm rolling in, Mark hopes the weather will push the Chamois down from their usual heights, giving him a rare chance to track this prey across the challenging landscape.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: It's 2016 and Mark heads down to Kansas for an early season Muzzleloader Whitetail hunt with Salt River Outfitters. It was hot in the stand with little deer movement until the moon phase switched and one of the bucks Mark had been looking for stepped out. Kansas is one of those states that has an early Muzzleloader season that opens in September, and if you can get the weather and the moon to align you can catch a big deer on his feet in daylight.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: After coming back from their road trip to Illinois, Jerry is looking to hit the Pennsylvania woods again in search of a buck named Flyer. This is a buck that Jerry passed up last year that he knew held a ton of potential, and after he started getting pictures of him this year, he knew he made the right call. The only problem is that this buck is a traveler and very unpredictable and could be anywhere at anytime. So trying to be in the right spot at the right time proves to be difficult for Jerry.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this adventure we travel to Colorado and hook up with an organization called "Angling with officers" and we jump in the boat with some courageous law enforcement officers from local departments. We also honor the Rapid City, SD SCHEELS Hometown Hero, David Pearcy!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to Missouri River near Chamberlain, SD and connect with the South Dakota chapter of Paralyzed Veterans of America for the Joel Niemeyer "Gone Fishing" event. We get to guide and share the story of 100 year old WW2 Veteran Kenneth Carlson and his family. We also honor our next Rochester, MN Scheels Hometown Hero, Dustin Draeger!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: WWII U.S. Navy veteran Bill Kruschel recounts a journey from humble beginnings in the midst of the Great Depression to his valuable service in the Navy, culminating in a lifelong commitment to the field of special education.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Kelli Campbell Goodnow honors the memory her husband…American hero Shawn Campbell.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Late October is one of the best times of the season to make a move, and Owen Reigler with Midwest Whitetail did just that on a great Iowa buck he calls the 6x6. With an active scrape line, an untouched clover plot, and a good idea of how the buck was using the area, Owen puts together the pieces for a perfect late-October setup.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Youth turkey season in Alabama is always special, but this one means a little bit more. Isaac takes Dylan Hunt to the woods for Alabama’s Youth Opening Weekend with hopes of calling in Dylan a gobbler. Youth season is all about passing on the tradition, and there’s nothing better than watching the next generation experience the thrill of turkey hunting.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Two of the best in the game, get to experience one unforgettable Nebraska hunt. Billy Yargus and Phillip Vanderpool are at Hidden Valley Outfitters in Arnold, Nebraska for a turkey hunt that turned into one they will never forget. Patience, experience, and elite calling paid off when these longbeards finally committed, and came all the way to 20 steps.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: The Alabama turkey opener is a tradition we look forward to every single year. This season, Aaron and Nick from The Hunting Public joined us in camp to kick things off and experience the opener with us. Good friends, strong tradition, and some Alabama gobblers made for an unforgettable start to the season.

programme.desc: Mike heads to one of the most prolific fisheries in SW Florida; South Seas Island Resort.

programme.desc: Josh and Anna set out for a last minute fishing trip that runs a little late. They take a quick detour to the parent pick up line to get the kids from school, and head back out on the water to see what’s biting!

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Josh takes his friend Isaiah to the blue water as they look for destin's latest hot bite, the blackfin tuna.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: In this episode of Flats Class, CA travels to South Carolina to fish for redfish with Captain Brian Vaughn, the Tide Master.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Capt. Ca and Capt. Brian Vaughn head out for seconds after an epic day in Hilton Head, SC.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Capt. CA Richardson and Capt. Socrates Conomos in Crystal River on the hunt for trophy Snook.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Capt CA is with fellow Captains for Clean Water advocate Cody Rubner in Jensen Beach, FL power fishing for Snook.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: A "Best of..." episode spanning the past 4 seasons of Winchester Life.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: After booking a trip at the last Indian River Clam Restoration banquete, the guys at Gold Key Roofing got a chance to fish with Capt. Blair and Capt. Mike Frenette.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Chris Broome takes Capt. Blair to catch snook at Marco Island.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Hunting isn't about the size of the buck, it's about something much bigger. Jeff Lindsey of The Lindsey Way gets to experience one of the most special moments a father and hunter can ask for, introducing his kids to the outdoors. These are the hunts they'll remember forever.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.
Clay and Crystal Charlton of Take-Em Outfitters are after everything big in Alberta! Giant Lake Trout, Monster Black Bear and Big Muleys!

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Hunting has a way of grounding us, reminding us of what truly matters: shared moments and unforgettable memories. Chance and Ashleigh Eckert are on their first out-of-state hunt in the rolling hills of Ohio. After overcoming a life-changing kidney transplant, their story is one of faith, love, and resilience. While the goal was a big buck, the true reward was the time spent together and the lessons learned along the way. Because hunting is about so much more than the harvest — it’s about the journey.

programme.title: Criminal Minds
programme.desc: Rossi questions his actions in the aftermath of a struggle with a serial killer who appears to have outsmarted the BAU.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: New DCI John Barnaby arrives in Midsomer and is bemused by the quaint villages and their quirky residents. But when a local DJ is crushed to death at a traditional girls' boarding school, he soon discovers that murder and deception are never far away. As the death toll rises, could Barnaby's first case also be his last?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The reclusive lives of elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham (Edward Fox and Phyllida Law) comes under police scrutiny when a social services investigator (Jeff Rawle) is murdered. Barnaby and Jones must unearth generations of family secrets and decipher astronomical charts to find the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young woman is dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway and a pub run by an ex-copper and former brothel madam. With the serial killer still at large, could history be repeating itself?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Jones goes undercover at the Oblong Foundation after one of the cult's young female members disappears suddenly. But he and Barnaby soon start digging into an old case involving the death of a couple in a boat explosion.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In Midsomer Mow, the gruesome discovery of a farmer's eviscerated body in an ancient stone circle is made just days before the spring equinox.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A VAT inspector goes missing as he hunts for an illicit cider still responsible for brewing The Beast, a potent local hooch. At the Midsomer Abbas spring fayre which celebrates its friendship with Midsomer Herne, Barnaby and Jones sample the local cider, while temperance preacher Norman Grigor calls on residents to repent of their drunken ways. Suddenly, Barnaby is violently ill as the body of missing man Peter Slim is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile Samuel Quested (Warren Clarke), the traditionalist mayor of Midsomer Abbas, seeks to revive the ancient rite known as 'The Stag'.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones investigate the cloistered world of Midsomer Priory when a nun is strangled to death. The detectives uncover a complex mystery involving holy orders, teenage romantic liaisons, African art and missing antique silver as the community is forced to open its doors to 21st-century policing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed. Patrick Morgan met his death while hoping to sight a rare bird, but is his obsession with ornithology to blame - or something more sinister?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When MATTHEW DRAPER, a quarry worker is killed by a demolition charge after obeying the orders of his foreman, IAN FRASER, to return to the unexploded device, no one can predict how it might effect the tranquil village of Fletcher's Cross nine years later...

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby's aunt, Alice Bly (Phyllis Calvert), has an addiction to detective stories, a deep admiration for her favourite nephew, and is recovering from an operation at the Lawnside Nursing Home. When a resident dies, Alice Bly picks up gossip which, mixed with the detective fiction with which she is passing the hours, makes her think that all is not as it should be at Lawnside.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Midsomer Mallow is one of the villages hoping to win the title of the "Perfect English Village" competition. As the story unfolds, not everything is "perfect" as local thief Peter Drinkwater is stabbed with a pitchfork at an abandoned farm, he's using as a squat. Shortly after robbing a retired actor's home. Despite the villagers' best efforts to keep the murder quiet so as to not ruin their chances in the competition, several further deaths occur eventually bringing Detective Chief Inspector Barnaby back several decades to uncover the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst the Upper Marshwood hunt assemble outside the village inn, a filthy tramp-like man leaves the shop and skulks into the wood. Soon after, he hears the sound of the hunt begin and the unforgettable noise of the horses and hounds in hot pursuit of the fox. Running for cover, towards the safety of his home-made shelter, he stumbles and falls into a pit - screaming. LIZA, isolated in the disused railway carriage which constitutes her home, moves deeper into the wood having heard the scream. She finds the pit and sees the tramp lying crumpled on the ground, clearly dead. She stares at him for a moment, then turns and walks away.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A disused airfield near Morton Fendle is the location for a romantic evening between young Simon Bright and his girlfriend Laura Sharp - absolutely nothing could ruin their date. The next morning, when Frances Kirby is out for her morning jog, she notices the vintage car they were in up at the airfield, containing Simon Bright's dead body, with Laura nowhere to be seen. Confused, Detective Chief Inspector Barnaby and D.S. Jones can't work out whether it was a suicide pact or murder. Furthermore, they've got to find Miss Sharp and their investigation leads them to linking Simon and Laura with the villagers of Morton Fendle, who met at Elaine Trim's dancing classes. Eventually, the Barnaby family plus Jones make it to a 40s style dance night at the village hall before more villagers start turning up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer County to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters, she gets a shock - Rex's staff had been told that she was dead. Things become even more complex when Rex's body is found in a nearby river, bearing wounds that suggest he was murdered. Barnaby and Jones are soon on the case, trying to establish who would have wanted the elderly man dead. Several people soon come forward with multiple wills, which confuse the matter, but when two more people, close friends of Rex, are also murdered, the investigation raises question on the motive, leading Barnaby to wonder if it was down to finances, passion, or something from Rex's past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Following the death of Alan King while on a business trip to China, the family company, King's Crystal, is in financial trouble. As plans to shut the Midsomer Magna factory are being put into action, Alan's wife Hilary and brother Charles are married in the village church - much to the dismay of Alan's son Ian. In addition to strife between members of the family, the factory workers are outraged at the loss of their jobs. So when company accountant Peter Baxter is found murdered, Barnaby and Jones suspect a disgruntled employee is to blame. But in order to investigate the matter further, Jones is forced to work undercover, and infiltrate the local group of Freemasons in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The music lovers of Midsomer County are delighted when a host of bands arrives for the Midsomer Rocks festival. Barnaby himself is particularly looking forward to seeing recently re-formed rock band, Hired Gun, perform on stage, but he soon gets close to the band for rather unfortunate reasons. During their opening performance, the band's singer, Mimi (Suzi Quatro), falls to the ground dead - electrocuted by a wire that had been run through the microphone stand. Barnaby and Jones soon find the rest of the band could be targets, and when another is killed, questions are raised as to whether former band member, Ginger Foxton, who went missing for 30 years and is presumed dead, is still at large. The detectives soon have to delve into a world of rock music, drug use and greed, to find the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The suspicious death of popular young GP Dr Alan Delaney brings Barnaby and Jones to Midsomer Market to investigate. The detectives are baffled as to a motive for murder - until they consider that the newly engaged Dr James Kirkwood may have been the intended victim. Before long, Barnaby and Jones are heading to Wales - former home to Delyth Mostyn, James's fiancee, to delve deeper into the mystery. There are certainly possible suspects in the murder and attempt on Kirkwood, from Delyth's children, who oppose the engagement, Delyth's husband, and more, as the detectives investigate things, in hopes of uncovering the truth before a major walk is to take place on Mount Snowdon.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the build-up to Luxton Deeping's annual photographic exhibition, a battle rages between the traditional and digital photographers of the pretty village. The dispute seems harmless enough - until Lionel Bell is found murdered in a nearby woodland, strangled with the cord of his light meter. Barnaby soon gets to work tracking down the killer, but it seems someone is trying to implicate the detective in the murder. And once he is replaced on the case, finding the culprit seems less likely than ever, as his replacement is more concerned of an upcoming wedding than the investigation. Barnaby is forced to work off the case to uncover who is framing him, and who wants dead other photographers in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Midsomer Magna are thrilled when a production crew arrives at the local manor house to film a version of The Scarlet Pimpernel. But the crew members aren't the only visitors to the area - Jones has spotted notorious criminal George Ince nearby. But when the director, Nick Cheney, is found dead - his head severed by a prop guillotine - Barnaby must discover who would have wanted the victim dead. It soon becomes clear that things are not so simple, and the detectives soon have to shift through varying motives, layered by lies, hidden truths, and a possible robbery to be committed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby is in Midsomer Holm, bidding farewell to reformed criminal Ronnie Tyler, who has taken part in a rehabilitation scheme in the village. Also present is disgraced ex-policeman Jack Colby, a former colleague of Barnaby's – but Jack refuses to talk to his old friend. When Jack is murdered, the detective must delve into the dark secrets in the victim's past. There are certainly dark secrets to uncover, and Barnaby has to determine whether the victim's part in a scandal years earlier at Causton police station, is key to the mystery behind his death. It isn't long before he finds that Eddie Marston is attempting blackmail, and soon murdered as a result, and that Lord Holm is in love with Jack's wife, psychotherapist Gina.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The demise of the Shirewell patriarch sparks a vicious inheritance dispute when eldest son Lucian announces plans to break up an estate that's been in his family for centuries.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the author of a book that sparked a nationwide treasure hunt is found dead, Barnaby and Winter must unravel the cryptic clues to find the killer among a group of dedicated seekers.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: After a pet detective turns up dead inside the kennel of a dog he was searching for, Barnaby and Winter are drawn into the world of dognapping, cat seduction, and animal investigation.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Sleepy Goodman's Land is known as the Greenest Village in Midsomer. But when the entire village is bought by a Texas oilman, a string of grisly murders ensues.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa

programme.desc: La historia entrelazada de tres romances, que se pondrán a prueba en sus diferentes etapas: el amor adolescente, el matrimonio y la vejez.

programme.title: Asesino de traileros
programme.desc: Los amos del camino son amenazados por un grupo de inconformes de su sindicato quienes asaltan y roban a los traileros.

programme.desc: Rebeca nunca imagin que al emigrar a los Estados Unidos a perseguir su sueo americano tendra que terminar trabajando como una masajista ertica en la casa de unas "vecinas" muy serviciales.

programme.title: Tres Reos
programme.desc: Tres peligrosos criminales son trasladados a una prisión de máxima seguridad. En el camino surge la oportunidad de escapar, desafiando al destino.

programme.title: Mi perfecto ex
programme.desc: Cata termina con su novio y supone que volverá de rodillas, rogando casarse con ella. Pero tiempo después lo encuentra siendo el hombre perfecto y a punto de casarse con otra.

programme.desc: Lupe es un pollero buscado por agentes de Migración. Michael García, un agente encubierto, le tiende una trampa cuando intenta cruzar la frontera de Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Destinos cruzados

programme.title: El clon
programme.desc: Said asegura que jamás renunciará a Jade. Ali teme que Jade se arriesgue por un amor incierto. Lidiane le expresa su preocupación a Maysa sobre Nando y su consumo de drogas. Deusa va a la clínica en busca de Léo y Albieri.
